text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired (INC-2026-0421). Service: embeddings-worker-us-west-2. Alert: 5xx_rate > 15% for 3m. Pager: @Diane

Diane: taking this. I'm oncall now, will triage. any known deploys? :thinking_face:

Ken: nothing from infra deploys in the last 30m. autoscaler did scale up but latency still high. seen a bunch of `OOMKilled` in the logs earlier.

Marcus: pinging — I saw a small model rollback 12m ago for a perf test in canary but shouldn't affect embeddings. i'll look at app logs.

Diane: ok first step: confirm scope and impact. Diane running quick check on queue depth + error logs.

Diane: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/service/embeddings | jq '.errors["5xx_rate"]'` -> ~17.4%

Anita: customer impact: internal monitoring shows elevated 5xx for API key group `enterprise-eu` — some retries hitting fallback to hosted model, increased latency for those customers.

Diane: marking SEV: high until we confirm isolation. I'll ack on PD and start a bridge.

pagerbot: @Diane acknowledged the PagerDuty incident (INC-2026-0421). Bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-0421

Marcus: digging into pod logs: lots of `KV cache miss` followed by `runtime: could not allocate memory` lines, then 5xx. looks like sudden memory pressure on embeddings workers.

Diane: running `kubectl -n inference top pods | sort -k3 -nr | head` -> several pods at ~89% mem.

Diane: quick mitigation: scale workers and bump node pool. `kubectl -n inference scale deployment embeddings-worker --replicas=20` and request infra to add one spicy-ml node.

Ken: triggering nodepool scale now. AWS ASG + taints. `terraform apply` in progress, but we can spin up a temporary node pool.

Anita: FYI customers seeing retries — added customer-impact tag on incident channel. Will alert CS to throttle notifications.

Marcus: i'm going to disable prefix caching for a subset to reduce mem spikes while we stabilize. applying config: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/embeddings-worker CACHE_PREFIX=false --record`

Diane: good. after scale + cache toggle, checking error rate...

(4m later)

Diane: update: replica count shows 20, new pods coming up. some pods still crash on init with OOM. logs show a recent model quantization flag set `--enable-quant-mode` that increases memory.

Marcus: that flag was part of yesterday's perf tuning, rolled to canary and then promoted. rolling it back now: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/embeddings-worker ENABLE_QUANT=0`

pagerbot: Deploybot: rollout started for deployment embeddings-worker by Marcus. Rollout: https://deploy.redwood/r/7890

Anita: taking over incident lead — Diane, i know you're crossing shift in ~10m. i'll continue primary if that's ok.

Diane: handing off to Anita. Leave a small checklist for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Diane: notes for handoff: 1) scale -> replicas 20 2) toggled CACHE_PREFIX to false 3) identified ENABLE_QUANT env as likely cause 4) CS notified 5) bridge active

Anita: got it. I'm on bridge. Marcus, keep monitoring logs and rollout status. Ken, keep an eye on nodepool scale.

(10m later)

Marcus: rollout completed. new pods stable, OOM logs gone. 5xx rate down to 2.1%.

Ken: nodepool scaled and drained a couple of bad nodes. infra will run a health check sweep.

Anita: customers impacted: few enterprise keys had degraded performance for ~18m, but retries handled most requests. CS notified top 5 accounts and we're opening incident tickets with them.

pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status: acknowledged -> mitigated (5xx_rate < 5%).

Anita: quick post-incident actions: - create JIRA INC-2026-0421 followup for root-cause and safer rollout gating; - add a test in canary to detect sudden memory growth with ENABLE_QUANT; - update runbook section 'embeddings memory surge' with steps we took.

Marcus: filing the JIRA now: RED-4567 "embeddings: quant flag caused memory surge in prod". linking to incident.

Diane: small note: consider adding an autoscaler metric for memory pressure, not just cpu. we've seen cpu-based autoscale miss memory spikes.

Ken: noted for infra backlog. will prep a proposal for autoscaler memory target next sprint.

Anita: final check — 5xx rate stable, no new alerts for the service in the last 8m. closing bridge. thanks all. :tada:

pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-0421 closed by Anita. Follow-ups: https://jira.redwood/RED-4567, runbook edit PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/212

Diane: thanks team. i'll add a short blameless note for execs and link the JIRA.

Marcus: good catch on the quant flag. we'll add stronger rollout gates.

Anita: incident closed. leaving final comment in JIRA and summarizing customer impact.

Ken: ✅
